notes: BC keeps the reported average in both scenarios; there is no delta and no dues comparison. A stumpage rate is not a delivered log price; the reported average is a price observation input, not a provincial net-value observation.

timber_dues_rate is a charge on standing timber, not a delivered log price. The scaled-minus-donor-flat delta is a model method effect. Stumpage, dues, royalty and standing-value rates are charges on standing timber. They are not delivered log prices: a delivered price embeds harvest, haul, road and silviculture cost plus a margin. Subtracting the same cost stack from a scaled dues rate double counts those costs if the result is read as a mill margin. Rates also differ in unit, species/grade, tenure, scaling and vintage. Deltas are therefore method changes, not observed market changes.
